Older BTC Is on the Move Again

“Movement doesn't necessarily mean selling or profit-taking. The Ledger migration might amplify this movement over the coming days.” – Read More

By nocoffeenobrain | @cryptoquant_official

[BTCUSDT] Abnormal Volatility Alert (15m)

20% discount on your fees at Bybit!

Analysts haven’t been this bullish on Bitcoin since August 2025.

• 84% of 164 analysts are now bullish, up from 37% in July.

• That’s more than at the same stage of the 2023 bull market, after half the price gain.

• It’s a genuine shift: 47 tracked analysts flipped from bear to bull, and only 5 went the other way.

• Macro desks moved first, going from 6% to 94% bullish. On-chain analysts, the largest group, are now 79% bullish.
